facts.text: The README describes the repository as a reinforcement learning implementation based on Unitree robots, supporting Go2, H1, H1_2 and G1
The go2 task is registered with the LeggedRobot class and the GO2RoughCfg and GO2RoughCfgPPO configs
task_registry.make_env constructs the registered task class with cfg, sim_params, physics_engine, sim_device and headless
task_registry.make_env applies the config seed with set_seed before it constructs the environment
set_seed seeds Python random, numpy, torch and PYTHONHASHSEED and also the CUDA generators
BaseTask.reset resets every environment and then calls step with a zero action, returning the observation and the privileged observation
BaseTask takes num_envs, num_obs, num_privileged_obs and num_actions from the config and allocates observation, reward, reset, episode-length and timeout buffers for num_envs environments
LeggedRobot.step clips the actions to plus or minus cfg.normalization.clip_actions, runs cfg.control.decimation physics substeps and then calls post_physics_step
LeggedRobot.step returns obs_buf, privileged_obs_buf, rew_buf, reset_buf and extras after clipping the observations
post_physics_step increments episode_length_buf and common_step_counter, checks terminations, computes rewards, resets the environments in reset_buf and computes the observations
check_termination sets reset_buf from termination contacts and base orientation, sets time_out_buf when episode_length_buf exceeds max_episode_length and ORs the timeout into reset_buf
reset_idx resets the DOFs and root states, resamples commands, clears action and episode-length buffers and sets reset_buf to 1 for the selected environments
compute_observations concatenates base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, commands, the scaled DOF position difference, DOF velocity and the actions
_compute_torques scales actions by cfg.control.action_scale and interprets them according to control_type P, V or T, clipping the torques to torque_limits
The DOF count and names come from the loaded asset
Default joint angles and PD gains are looked up by DOF name
LeggedRobot sets self.dt to cfg.control.decimation multiplied by sim_params.dt
The maximum episode length is ceil(episode_length_s / self.dt)
The base env config defaults to 4096 environments, 48 observations and 12 actions
The base control config defaults to decimation 4
The base normalization config clips actions to 100.0
The base sim config uses a 0.005 s timestep
The PPO config default seed is 1
GO2RoughCfg extends LeggedRobotCfg and its control section sets control_type P, action_scale 0.25 and decimation 4
GO2RoughCfg lists twelve default joint angles, four for each of the hip, thigh and calf groups
GO2RoughCfg loads the Go2 URDF from resources/robots/go2/urdf/go2.urdf
setup.py install_requires lists isaacgym, rsl-rl, matplotlib, numpy, tensorboard, mujoco and pyyaml; it names no serial, USB or DDS hardware transport

determinism.notes: the fake applies one closed-form transition per tick and is repeatable for a fixed action sequence, but the upstream environment has no post-construction integer seed and no get_state/set_state, so this package makes no seeded replay claim and does not bind cap.world.seed.v1

gaps: the fake is a pure-Python analytic stand-in for the go2 training environment, not the upstream Isaac Gym simulator: it runs no PhysX, contact, terrain, URDF or reward computation, and its observation, reward and termination values are placeholders

the base config defaults to 4096 parallel environments, 48 observations and 12 actions (legged_gym/envs/base/legged_robot_config.py:5-8); the fake returns 1 environment by default (a caller may ask for 2 through the fake option num_envs) and its 48-value observation and 12-action vector are placeholder shapes, so a receipt is smaller than the upstream default

the upstream step runs cfg.control.decimation physics substeps per control action (legged_gym/envs/base/legged_robot.py:60; go2 decimation 4, sim dt 0.005 s, legged_gym/envs/go2/go2_config.py:31 and legged_gym/envs/base/legged_robot_config.py:155), a 20 ms control period; the fake advances one closed-form transition per tick without integrating those substeps

the fake does not model the Go2 URDF, joint limits, PD gains, torques, commands, contacts, terrain, domain randomization or the reward functions; it only carries the action into a placeholder observation, and it clips the action to a placeholder 100.0 rather than the environment's configured cfg.normalization.clip_actions

no seed control or snapshot/restore: the upstream seed is applied before construction (legged_gym/utils/task_registry.py:64 and legged_gym/utils/helpers.py:42-47), the environment exposes no post-construction integer seed and no get_state/set_state, so the package declares no seeded replay claim
no rendering: the Isaac Gym viewer is not exposed, and no cap.world.render.v1 is bound
the sim backend factory (.driver:make_env) was not run: it needs the installed upstream package, isaacgym and torch (setup.py:11), and the gate and these tests use the fake only
policy action bounds are operator_required; site-limits.example.json contains illustrative fake-scale bounds, not joint travel limits or an approved live deployment envelope

safe_state.description: the software e-stop latch refuses further step and reset calls; an in-flight native control transition may finish, and the last observation, tick and episode counters stay readable
